name: Residence Permit for Independent Economic Activity (Article 24)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a minimum capital of EUR 60,000 deposited in a Greek bank account to fund the independent economic activity, which must be shown to contribute to the growth of the national economy.
requirements.fix_path: Deposit the qualifying capital and prepare a business plan demonstrating economic contribution.

requirements.blocker_text: A special entry visa for the purpose of independent economic activity must be obtained before the residence permit application.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the special entry visa at a Greek consulate.

evidence_required.document: Business plan / documentation of economic contribution
Special entry visa for independent economic activity

sources.title: Greek Ministry of Foreign Affairs -- Codification of Legislation, Article 24 (independent economic activity, EUR 60,000 minimum capital, special visa requirement)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Greece's initial build. work_rights set to 'restricted' since the permit only authorises the specific self-employed activity documented at application, not general employment -- this is an inference from the nature of the route rather than an explicit tier-1 statement of the enum-level restriction, flagged for honesty. duration_length left as a placeholder string: the codification excerpt fetched did not state the exact initial validity period for this specific article (distinguishable from Article 26's stated 2+3-year structure).
